linkedin_headline: CEO & Founder at Mailmodo | Building interactive emails
linkedin_about:
I'm building Mailmodo to make email interactive. Our platform lets companies collect data, run surveys, accept payments, and more—directly in email. It's the fastest growing way to reach users without friction.

Over the past few years, I've learned that email is one of the most underutilized channels for product engagement. We're changing that.
